## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Ensure the sponsor address is registered before calling sponsored_withdraw. Register via register_sponsor if needed.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let sponsor = Address::generate(&f.env);
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
rejected!(sponsored_claim(&f, &sponsor, id, 1, 1, { f.env.ledger().timestamp() + DAY }));
```
